svg.desc: Madinah Lighting, Electricity & Renewable Energy LOCATION Al Madinah Al Munawwarah, KSA CLIENT Madinah Regional Municipality STATUS EST. VALUE In Progress 375 million SAR DISCIPLINES Structural / Civil Engineering Mechanical Engineering Electrical Engineering Project Overview This ongoing project in Madinah, KSA, commissioned by the Madinah Municipality, involves the rehabilitation and operation of road and district lighting systems, with an estimated construction value of 375 million SAR. Services include supervision, approvals, design reviews, and progress reporting throughout execution. BECT's scope included conceptual design, detailed drawings, tender documents, site supervision and project management.
